title: CompilationError(PrepareError(Deserialization)) on deploy (does not reproduce on current testnet)
summary: Reports from 2023 to 2025 attribute this deploy-time error to wasm built with newer Rust (1.82+) enabling wasm features that nearcore did not yet accept; `cargo near build` post-processes the module. We could not reproduce it on current infrastructure, so this rule is historical: it explains the error when pasted but never warns by default.
message: Hand-rolled wasm build in {file}:{line} (historical risk; see R-001).

steps: If you see this error, build with `cargo near build` (it post-processes the wasm) and compare against a known-good example contract.
On older nodes or toolchains, reports mention pinning Rust to 1.81 or running wasm-opt manually; check which node version you deploy to.
The most-cited cause is the wasm module's features, not the RPC or the SDK; check how the wasm was built before changing either.
fix.agent: Replace the plain `cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` in {file} at line {line} with `cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm`.

reproduction.sandbox: near-workspaces 0.24: a raw plain-cargo wasm (rustc 1.100.0; target_features bulk-memory, bulk-memory-opt, call-indirect-overlong, multivalue, mutable-globals, nontrapping-fptoint, reference-types, sign-ext) deployed and `new` succeeded
reproduction.testnet: the same wasm deployed and initialised on live testnet (node 2.14.1, protocol 88) on 2026-11-13
